title: 2025年12月四级真题 第1套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 All living organisms on Earth are exposed to a 24-hour day-night cycle. This cycle is the reason why people rest at night and are active during the day. Consequently, all human body functions also follow this daily rhythm, and the timing of behaviors like exercise or food intake can significantly influence your health. For example, eating at night can lead to weight gain over time because food intake at night leads to increased fat storage.

P2 Many drug targets in the body follow a 24-hour cycle, too. This means that the specific proteins a drug is designed to modify can react differently to the medicine over the course of a 24-hour time period. Because how the body responds to a drug can differ depending on the time it is taken, it logically follows that taking medicines at specific times could help increase their effectiveness and reduce unwanted side effects.

P3 When doctors prescribe medicine for people, they rarely consider the best time to take it. There are two main reasons for that oversight. First, many physicians are not aware that some drugs work better during a specific time of the day. And second, most drugs have not been studied for possible different effects during a 24-hour cycle. Therefore, patients are directed to take most drugs during the morning or evening primarily to ensure compliance.

P4 Over 50 years ago, researchers found that the cholesterol drug simvastatin is more effective at lowering cholesterol levels when taken at night rather than during the day. This is because the liver enzyme(酶) these drugs target is more active at night.

P5 Taking medicine at the wrong time can even cause harm. My colleagues and I wondered whether midazolam, the most common sedative(镇静剂) used in surgical procedures worldwide, might interfere with the internal clock that protects the heart at night. Currently, there are no guidelines regarding when midazolam should be administered.

P6 More research is needed to determine the best times to administer treatments for different diseases. I believe taking drug timing into account could help make treatments more effective and help more people worldwide.

questions.q: What do we learn from the passage about the timing of our behaviors?
options: It has a considerable impact on our health.
It confines us to a 24-hour day-night cycle.
It requires us to follow a particular rhythm.
It holds the key to all human body functions.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn from the passage about ... 问的是文章就「行为时机」明说了什么， 答案应能在原文直接找到对应句，不需推断。 46. What do we learn from the passage about the timing of our behaviors? A) It has a considerable impact on our health. B) It confines us to a 24-hour day-night cycle. C) It requires us to follow a particular rhythm. D) It holds the key to all human body functions.

【拆句】题干 What do we learn from the passage about the timing of our behaviors? 是一个 what 引导的特殊疑问句，主干是「我们从文中得知什么」，about 短语把范围锁定在「我 们行为的时机」上。结构平铺直叙，无从句、无否定，唯一要抓的是 about 后面的话题 词，它指明这道题只问「行为时机」相关的内容。

【定位】Consequently, all human body functions also follow this daily rhythm, and the timing of behaviors like exercise or food intake can significantly influence your health. 因此，人体的所有功能也都遵循这一日常节律，而锻炼、进食等行为的时机会显著影响你的 健康。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 can significantly influence your health ↔It has a considerable impact on our health 预判「行为时机大大影响健康」与 It has a considerable impact on our health 完全吻 合，故锁定该项。 B) 偷换概念 原文是「昼夜周期导致行为有节律」，It confines us to a 24-hour day-night cycle 却 说「行为时机把我们限制在 24 小时周期里」，把因当成了果，与原文 This cycle is the reason why people rest at night and are active during the day 相悖。 C) 张冠李戴 It requires us to follow a particular rhythm 说「行为时机要求我们遵循某节律」，但 原文里「遵循节律」的主体是人体功能（all human body functions also follow this daily rhythm），并非由「行为时机」提出要求。 D) 过度推断 It holds the key to all human body functions 称行为时机「掌握着人体所有功能的关 键」，原文只说人体功能遵循节律、行为时机影响健康，从未说时机决定一切功能，all 与 holds the key 属夸大。 作者关于我们体内的蛋白质说了什么? A) 它们能以不同方式改变药物的效果。 B) 它们能减少某些药物不想要的副作用。 C) 它们对药物的反应在昼夜周期中会发生变化。 D) 它们的设计决定了它们对药物反应的不同方式。

questions.q: What does the author say about the proteins in our body?
options: They can modify the effects of medicines in different ways.
They can reduce unwanted side effects of certain medicines.
Their reaction to medicines changes during the day-night cycle.
Their design determines how differently they react to medicines.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about the proteins 问作者对蛋白质的明确陈述，答案落在讲 蛋白质的那句话里，属客观查找而非推断。 47. What does the author say about the proteins in our body? A) They can modify the effects of medicines in different ways. B) They can reduce unwanted side effects of certain medicines. C) Their reaction to medicines changes during the day-night cycle. D) Their design determines how differently they react to medicines.

【拆句】题干 What does the author say about the proteins in our body? 主干是「作者关于我 们体内的蛋白质说了什么」，say about 后面的 the proteins in our body 是话题。注意四 个选项都是完整句子，需要逐个判断哪句和原文一致，题干本身无陷阱。

【定位】This means that the specific proteins a drug is designed to modify can react differently to the medicine over the course of a 24-hour time period. 这意味着，药物所要作用的那些特定蛋白质，在 24 小时的进程中对药物的反应可能各不 相同。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 They can modify the effects of medicines in different ways 说「蛋白质改变药物的 效果」，但原文是药物去作用（modify）蛋白质（the specific proteins a drug is designed to modify），施受关系正好相反。 B) 张冠李戴 They can reduce unwanted side effects of certain medicines 把「减少副作用」说 成蛋白质的能力，可原文里减副作用的是「按特定时间服药」这一做法（taking medicines at specific times could help increase their effectiveness and reduce unwanted side effects），与蛋白质无关。 C) ✓ 正确 can react differently to the medicine over the course of a 24-hour time period ↔ Their reaction to medicines changes during the day-night cycle 预判「蛋白质对药反应随时段变化」正是 Their reaction to medicines changes during the day-night cycle 所述，锁定该项。 D) 无中生有 Their design determines how differently they react to medicines 称「蛋白质的 设计决定其反应差异」，原文从未谈蛋白质有何 design，更没说设计决定反应，纯属 臆造。 医生在为人们开药时会做什么? A) 他们很少考虑服药时间以达到最大效果。 B) 他们很少考虑哪种药物对哪个患者更有效。 C) 他们告诉患者药物在24小时内可能产生的副作用。 D) 他们告诉患者遵守药品生产商的说明。

questions.q: What do doctors do when prescribing medicine for people?
options: They give little thought to the time of taking it for maximum effect.
They rarely consider which medicine works better for which patient.
They tell patients its possible side effects during a period of 24 hours.
They tell patients to comply with the directions of drug manufacturers.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do doctors do when prescribing medicine 问医生实际做了什么，是可在原文直接 核对的事实。 48. What do doctors do when prescribing medicine for people? A) They give little thought to the time of taking it for maximum effect. B) They rarely consider which medicine works better for which patient. C) They tell patients its possible side effects during a period of 24 hours. D) They tell patients to comply with the directions of drug manufacturers.

【拆句】题干 What do doctors do when prescribing medicine for people? 主干「医生开药时做 什么」，when prescribing 是时间状语（现在分词作状语，相当于 when they prescribe）。结构清晰，关键是抓 doctors 与 prescribing 这一动作场景。

【定位】When doctors prescribe medicine for people, they rarely consider the best time to take it. 医生给人们开药时，很少考虑服药的最佳时间。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 they rarely consider the best time to take it ↔ They give little thought to the time of taking it for maximum effect 预判「医生很少考虑最佳服药时间」与 They give little thought to the time of taking it for maximum effect 一致，锁定该项。 B) 偷换概念 They rarely consider which medicine works better for which patient 把疏忽的对象 换成「哪种药对哪个病人更好」，而原文疏忽的是服药「时间」，话题被悄悄换掉。 C) 偷换概念 They tell patients its possible side effects during a period of 24 hours 说医生告知 24 小时内的副作用，原文讲的是药物未被研究其昼夜差异（most drugs have not been studied for possible different effects during a 24-hour cycle），并非医生告 知副作用。 D) 偷换概念 They tell patients to comply with the directions of drug manufacturers 说让病人遵 从药厂说明，但原文 compliance 指病人遵从医嘱按时服药（patients are directed to take most drugs during the morning or evening primarily to ensure compliance），并未提 drug manufacturers。 为什么医生建议患者在早上或晚上服用大多数药物? A) 为了阻止他们提出投诉。 B) 为了确保他们按照指示服药。 C) 为了严格遵守新的研究发现。 D) 为了保证药物的最大效果。

questions.q: Why do doctors advise patients to take most drugs in the morning or in the evening?
options: To discourage them from making complaints.
To ensure they take the drugs as instructed.
To comply with new research findings strictly.
To guarantee the maximum effect of the drugs.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why do doctors advise ... 问的是原文已经给出的理由，定位到目的状语即可作答，不需自 己推因果。 49. Why do doctors advise patients to take most drugs in the morning or in the evening? A) To discourage them from making complaints. B) To ensure they take the drugs as instructed. C) To comply with new research findings strictly. D) To guarantee the maximum effect of the drugs.

【拆句】题干 Why do doctors advise patients to take most drugs in the morning or in the evening? 是 why 引导的因果问句，主干「医生为何建议病人在早上或晚上服大多数药」。 advise sb. to do 是「建议某人做某事」结构。问 why 意味着答案是原文里这一建议背后的 目的或原因。

【定位】Therefore, patients are directed to take most drugs during the morning or evening primarily to ensure compliance. 因此，病人被指示在早上或晚上服用大多数药物，主要是为了确保遵医服药。

【选项】A) 无中生有 To discourage them from making complaints 说目的是「阻止病人投诉」，原文目的 只有 ensure compliance，从未提 complaints，凭空捏造。 B) ✓ 正确 to ensure compliance ↔To ensure they take the drugs as instructed 预判「为确保病人按医嘱服药」与 To ensure they take the drugs as instructed 同 义，锁定该项。 C) 与原文相反 To comply with new research findings strictly 说目的是严格遵循新研究成果，但原文 恰恰指出多数药未做昼夜研究（most drugs have not been studied），医生让早晚服 药并非依据研究，方向相反。 D) 与原文相反 To guarantee the maximum effect of the drugs 说目的是保证药效最大，但全文论点 正是医生没考虑增效时机（they rarely consider the best time to take it），早晚服药 并非为了药效最大化，正好相反。 作者在文章结尾处建议了什么? A) 在为患者开药时考虑服药时机。 B) 通过将服药时机纳入考虑使治疗变得不那么复杂。 C) 开展更多研究以找出治疗不同疾病的最佳时机。 D) 通过进一步研究找出治疗疾病最有效的药物。

questions.q: What does the author suggest near the end of the passage?
options: Considering drug-taking timing when prescribing drugs for patients.
Making treatments less complex by taking drug timing into account.
Conducting more studies to find out the best timing for treating different diseases.
Finding out the most effective drugs for treating diseases through further research.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author suggest near the end 问作者在收尾处的整体主张，需要把末段的 呼吁概括出来，而非抓某个孤立细节。

【拆句】题干 What does the author suggest near the end of the passage? 主干「作者在文章接 近结尾处建议了什么」，suggest 在此是「建议、主张」，near the end of the passage 是地点状语，明确把答案锁在文章末段。这是一道带位置提示的建议题。 50. What does the author suggest near the end of the passage? A) Considering drug-taking timing when prescribing drugs for patients. B) Making treatments less complex by taking drug timing into account. C) Conducting more studies to find out the best timing for treating different diseases. D) Finding out the most effective drugs for treating diseases through further research.

【选项】A) 以偏概全 Considering drug-taking timing when prescribing drugs for patients 是第三段对 医生开药的观点延伸，而题干问的是 near the end 的建议；末段真正的呼吁是「做更多 研究」，而非这条局部主张。 B) 无中生有 Making treatments less complex by taking drug timing into account 称考虑服 药时机可让治疗「不那么复杂」，原文末段只说能让治疗更有效、惠及更多人（could help make treatments more effective and help more people worldwide），从未提 less complex。 C) ✓ 正确 More research is needed to determine the best times to administer treatments for different diseases ↔Conducting more studies to find out the best timing for treating different diseases 预判「需更多研究找最佳给药时机」与 Conducting more studies to find out the best timing for treating different diseases 完全对应，锁定该项。 D) 偷换概念 Finding out the most effective drugs for treating diseases through further research 说要研究「最有效的药物」，可末段研究的目标是「最佳给药时间」（the best times to administer treatments），全文谈的是时机而非药物本身，对象被 偷换。
